evidence.fact: A controller observes deletionTimestamp, performs finalizer work, and removes its key only after the condition is satisfied; deletion occurs when no finalizers remain.
After deletion begins, finalizers may be removed but not added, deletionTimestamp is immutable, and the object cannot be resurrected.
The pv-protection finalizer keeps an in-use volume terminating until the consuming Pod no longer uses it.
